I'm computing the N-CA-CB-CG dihedral angle for LEU62 by finding the bond vectors between consecutive atoms and then taking cross products to get the normal vectors needed for the torsion calculation.

Working through the dot products and magnitudes, the cosine of the angle comes out to roughly -0.9998, giving a dihedral near 180°. Checking the sign via b1·n2 gives a value essentially zero, confirming the angle is exactly trans (t) at approximately 180 degrees.
